# Saved replies

The [Implementation Progress](./implementation-progress.md) [saved reply](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/writing-on-github/working-with-saved-replies/creating-a-saved-reply) can be left as a comment on a Discussion that proposes a modification to an existing feature or introduces a new one to the specification. This comment is then intended to be used to track the progress of this feature being implemented, following the guidance of GA4GH's [Technical Specification Development](https://www.ga4gh.org/document/tasc-technical-specification-development/) policy.
